_comment: Written by the trading runs. impliedMove is a decimal or null. null means the straddle was not pulled - an open checklist item, not a placeholder to guess at. This file is a list of what is AHEAD: the pre-close run prunes catalysts once their date has passed and re-reads spot from a live quote, because a reference price carried from the day it was written makes every implied range wrong.
prunedNote: PRUNED AGAINST A LIVE CALENDAR RE-PULLED FOR 2026-08-26 THROUGH 2026-08-29, AND ALL THREE DUTIES ARE RECORDED AS PERFORMED RATHER THAN SKIPPED. NOTHING WAS REMOVED, AND THE REASON IS THAT THE ONE CATALYST HERE HAS NOT PASSED YET: the NVDA row is dated 2026-08-26 after the close and this run fired at 15:35, roughly twenty-five minutes AHEAD of it. It was re-verified on this pull as NVDA, 2026-08-26, timing pm, verified true, no actual yet, estimate 2.09 for fiscal Q2 2027 - unchanged from the 8/25 pull. THE 8/27 OPEN OWNS REMOVING IT, once the number is out and it is genuinely behind rather than ahead. THE CARRIED SPOT WAS REFRESHED FROM A LIVE QUOTE AND IT MOVED DOWN AGAIN: 210.60 bid at 19:35:20.202763556Z against the 212.36 written here yesterday, DOWN 1.76 or 0.83%, and down 1.15% on the session against a 213.05 settled close. So the row now sits 8.81 below the 219.41 it was written at on 8/21, 4.02%. Five of the six refreshes this row has taken have moved it down; yesterday's was the single exception. That is the entire case for refreshing as a rule rather than when the drift looks worth the bother - the row is never wrong in one direction, it is just stale, and a file that centres its implied range on a price from the day it was written is describing a market that is not there. WHAT THIS RUN ADDS IS A ROW RATHER THAN A DELETION, AND IT IS A CORRECTION TO THIS FILE'S OWN STRUCTURE. MRVL has been recorded inside the NVDA row's prose since 8/21 rather than as a catalyst of its own - a reasonable economy while it was six sessions out and the NVDA row was the live one. It stops being reasonable tonight. MRVL reports 2026-08-27 after the close, re-verified on this pull, estimate 0.87 for fiscal Q2 2027, and the row it was buried in is the row tomorrow's open is supposed to delete. A catalyst whose only home is inside another catalyst's obituary is a catalyst this file will lose on exactly the morning it matters, so MRVL now has its own row, its own live spot at 243.67 bid, and its own branches each carrying its own why. THE REFUSAL ITSELF IS UNCHANGED AND IS NOT RE-ARGUED: an 8% stop cannot survive an event gap in either direction, and a sympathy name carries the index gap without carrying the index's liquidity. It was tested at its hardest yesterday, when the whole complex ripped into its own print instead of falling into it, and it held because it never rested on a view about direction. AMD'S MECHANICAL BLOCK TIGHTENED AGAIN: 481.97 bid, +0.58% on the session, and one share is 47.76% of a 1009.16 account against the 40% single-name ceiling - up from 47.54% yesterday and 45.13% the day before. AMD is blocked by an explicit arithmetic limit before any view about NVDA reaches it. IMPLIED MOVE STAYS NULL ON BOTH ROWS AND THE CHECK OWED TO THIS RUN IS DISCHARGED RATHER THAN SKIPPED: item 3 is owed before an earnings HOLD, both position lists returned empty on a live pull so there is no hold to place it before, branch one refuses the whole complex through 8/27 so nothing is contemplated either, and a straddle quoted for a position nobody will take measures nothing. A number that was not pulled does not get written down as though it were. THE BOOK GOES INTO TONIGHT'S PRINT FLAT, WHICH IS WHAT THESE BRANCHES WERE WRITTEN SIX SESSIONS EARLY TO PRODUCE, AND AS OF THIS RUN IT IS ACTUAL RATHER THAN ANTICIPATED.

moves.source: Spot REFRESHED LIVE at 19:35:20.202763556Z on 8/26 by the pre-close run, not carried from the day the row was written: 210.60 bid / 210.62 ask on a 0.01% spread, last trade 210.600, against a 213.05 settled close on 8/25 - DOWN 1.15% on the session and DOWN 0.83% from the 212.36 this row carried yesterday. Five of this row's six refreshes have moved it down; yesterday's upward one was the exception. Cumulatively it now sits 8.81 under the 219.41 it was written at on 8/21, 4.02%. THE EVENT IS TONIGHT AND HAS NOT PASSED, which is why this row was not pruned: re-verified on a live earnings-calendar pull covering 2026-08-26 to 2026-08-29 as NVDA, 2026-08-26, timing pm, verified true, no actual yet, estimate 2.09 for fiscal Q2 2027, unchanged from the 8/25 pull. The 8/27 open owns removing it. impliedMove is null because NO STRADDLE WAS PULLED, and that is a discharged check rather than an outstanding one: this board holds nothing into the print, both position lists returned empty on a live pull at 15:35, branch one refuses the whole complex through 8/27 so nothing is contemplated either, and item 3 is owed only before an earnings hold. MRVL IS NO LONGER RECORDED HERE - IT HAS ITS OWN ROW as of this run, because this row is the one tomorrow's open deletes and a catalyst buried inside a deleted row is a catalyst lost on the morning it matters. AMD stays recorded here as the transmission mechanism rather than as a row, and its arithmetic tightened again: 481.97 bid at 19:35:19.696938814Z, +0.58% on the session, and one share is 47.76% of a 1009.16 account against the 40% single-name ceiling, up from 47.54% yesterday. AMD is blocked mechanically before any view about tonight reaches it.

branches.cond: An entry considered in the AI or semiconductor complex - AMD, SMCI, MRVL, or any sympathy name - on 8/25, 8/26 or 8/27, into either print
branches.act: Refused, decided now rather than on the day
branches.why: The rulebook forbids holding an option through a print outright, and for equity the -8% stop has to survive the event or it is not a stop. This board has already refused SMCI once on exactly that arithmetic - a 14.4% implied move swallows an 8% stop, so the realistic bad case gaps through the exit rather than filling at it. NVDA own move is not the exposure here; the exposure is that a sympathy name carries the index gap without carrying its liquidity, which is the 2026-08-10 finding about four names off one list being one position at four times the size. THE DATE RANGE WAS WIDENED ON 8/21 AND THE REASON IS RECORDED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED OVER. This branch originally read 8/25 or 8/26 and would have been silent on 8/27, when MRVL reports after the close - a second dated semiconductor print the row had not named. The extra day is not a new judgement and changes no arithmetic; the wording was under-inclusive and a live calendar pull found it. Two prints on consecutive evenings also means the complex carries event risk across BOTH nights, so a position opened on 8/26 to trade the NVDA reaction is holding into MRVL, which is the same refusal one day later rather than a clean second entry. Writing the refusal down six sessions early is the point: on 8/26 it would be a view about the report, and today it is a mechanical consequence of a stop that cannot hold.

branches.cond: A position from an unrelated setup is open and running into 8/26
branches.act: DECIDED AND DISCHARGED AT 15:35 ON 8/26: nothing is open, so nothing is held through the print
branches.why: A name outside the complex is not automatically exposed, and this row must not become a reason to close good positions early on a date that has nothing to do with them. But an NVDA print is the one evening a session where correlation appears in names that showed none for a month, so the hold cannot be passive. Item 3 binds: no straddle pulled means no earnings hold, and that applies to a position held THROUGH the event even when the event belongs to another ticker whose gap it will wear. THIS BRANCH IS NOW ANSWERED RATHER THAN PENDING. The 8/26 pre-close queried both position lists live against the mandated account at 15:35 and both returned empty, so there is no unrelated position to decide and no hold to place a straddle before. The only thing that was live today - the 09:49 SMTC specification at a 138.50 limit - expired unexecuted on its 15:30 fuse and was explicitly NOT re-struck, in part for this exact reason: re-striking it would have carried a semiconductor position through tonight's print, which is the event its own forced marking already named as failure number two.

branches.cond: The complex sells off into 8/26 and a name on this board looks cheap for it
branches.act: Not bought on that basis, and re-approached only from 8/27 on the reaction bar
branches.why: Cheapness ahead of a dated binary is not a setup - it is the binary being priced, and buying it is taking the event risk the branch above just refused. This is the same reasoning that has kept KLAR unbought through a 22% gap all day: the first print of a fall is not a support level. The post-print session is the first point the rulebook can engage at all, and item 2 then governs - the reaction day is not the entry, the day-2 or day-3 pullback that holds is.

moves.source: PROMOTED TO ITS OWN ROW ON 8/26 BY THE PRE-CLOSE RUN, having been recorded inside the NVDA row's prose since 8/21. The reason is structural rather than a change of view: the NVDA row is dated tonight and tomorrow's open is supposed to delete it, so a catalyst whose only home is inside that row is a catalyst this file loses on the morning it becomes the live one. Re-verified on a live earnings-calendar pull covering 2026-08-26 to 2026-08-29: MRVL, 2026-08-27, timing pm, verified true, no actual yet, estimate 0.87 for fiscal Q2 2027 - unchanged from the 8/25 pull. Spot is a LIVE quote and not carried: 243.67 bid / 243.78 ask at 19:35:20.083281141Z on a 0.05% spread, last trade 243.725, against a 240.38 settled close - UP 1.37% on the session, and up 2.12% from the 238.61 the NVDA row recorded for it yesterday. THE SEQUENCING IS THE WHOLE POINT OF THIS ROW: MRVL reports the evening AFTER NVDA, so a position opened tomorrow to trade the NVDA reaction is a position holding into the MRVL print. That is not a clean second entry, it is the same refusal one day later, and it is the reason branch one on the NVDA row was widened from 8/26 to 8/27 on 8/21. impliedMove is null because NO STRADDLE WAS PULLED: nothing is open, branch one refuses the complex through 8/27 so nothing is contemplated, and item 3 is owed only before an earnings hold. A number that was not pulled does not get written down as though it were. The 8/28 open owns pruning this row once the print is out.

branches.cond: An entry considered in MRVL itself, or in a semiconductor sympathy name, on 8/27 into this print
branches.act: Refused, decided now rather than on the day
branches.why: This is the NVDA row's branch one applied to the second print rather than a new judgement, and it is written here so that deleting the NVDA row tomorrow does not delete the reasoning with it. The rulebook forbids holding an option through a print outright, and for equity the -8% stop has to survive the event or it is not a stop. This board has already refused SMCI on exactly that arithmetic - a 14.4% implied move swallows an 8% stop, so the realistic bad case gaps through the exit rather than filling at it - and refused SMTC a hold through tonight on the same item 3 test this morning. Nothing about MRVL's own move is the exposure being priced here; the exposure is that a stop cannot be honoured across a gap, in either direction, and one evening's rally does not change that arithmetic any more than one evening's sell-off does.

branches.cond: NVDA's print tonight moves MRVL hard before its own report tomorrow evening
branches.act: Not traded on that move, in either direction, before 8/28
branches.why: A sympathy gap on someone else's number, with the name's OWN dated binary still ahead of it the following evening, is the worst version of the setup this file exists to refuse: it takes the index gap without the index's liquidity, and then holds a second event on top of it. Cheapness after an NVDA miss is the MRVL binary being priced, not a support level, and strength after an NVDA beat is a continuation spike into a print, which item 2 calls a wait signal. The first point the rulebook can engage this name at all is the 8/28 session, after both numbers are known, and item 2 then governs - the reaction day is not the entry, the day-2 or day-3 pullback that holds is.

branches.cond: A position from an unrelated setup is open and running into 8/27
branches.act: The 8/27 pre-close decides it explicitly against this row, and a hold through the print requires the straddle pulled first
branches.why: The same test the 8/26 pre-close applied to the NVDA row, restated here for the second print so the duty survives the first row being deleted. A name outside the complex is not automatically exposed and must not be closed early on a date that has nothing to do with it, but two semiconductor prints on consecutive evenings is precisely when correlation shows up in names that showed none for a month. Item 3 binds either way: no straddle pulled means no earnings hold, and that applies to a position held THROUGH an event belonging to another ticker whose gap it will nonetheless wear.
